#!/bin/sh

REPO_DIR="/global/homes/i/ibrahime/temp/OmniLearnLightining/"
OUTPUT_DIR="/pscratch/sd/i/ibrahime/checkpoints/pretrained_micro_super_gen/"
DATASET_PATH="/pscratch/sd/i/ibrahime/datasets/"

PRETRAINED_CKPT="/global/cfs/cdirs/m3246/Omnilearned_Study/PretrainStepSweep/Medium/classifier/.staged/class_only-step=00002500-val_loss=0.7666.ckpt"
FINETUNING_DATASET="top"

TOKENIZER_CKPT="${REPO_DIR}/assets/kmeans_model_2025-12-17-19-08-10-Dry-Gondola_noAddInfo_8192_codes.pth"
DATASET_SIZE="-1"

POS_ENCODING_TYPE="sort_descending_in_masked_subset"
MASKING_FRACTION=0.4

VAL_CHECK=1171
PATIENCE=5

# For finetuning vs from-scratch
TRAINING_CFG_ALL_SIZES="--use_wandb y --wandb_project omnilearned --limit_val_batches=1.0 --val_check_interval=${VAL_CHECK} --dataset=${FINETUNING_DATASET} --dataset_size=${DATASET_SIZE} --fine_tune y --ckpt /global/cfs/cdirs/m3246/Omnilearned_Study/PretrainStepSweep/Medium/classifier/.staged/class_only-step=00002500-val_loss=0.7666.ckpt --use_pid n --use_add n --epoch=99999 --max_training_steps=35130 --scheduler_total_steps=35130 --adjust_scheduler_steps_to_trainer_estimated_steps n --outdir=${OUTPUT_DIR} --path=${DATASET_PATH} --shuffle_val_test_indices y --seed_for_initial_shuffling=0 --patience=${PATIENCE} --pos_encoding_type=${POS_ENCODING_TYPE} --masking_fraction=${MASKING_FRACTION} --accumulate_grad_batches=1 --use_one_cycle=n"

# Size-specific hyperparams
TRAINING_CFG_SIZE_SPECIFIC="--num_workers=2 --num_nodes=4 --model_size=medium --lr 1e-06 --weight_decay 5 --batch_size=64 --wandb_tag=top-finetuning --lr_factor=5 --scheduler_warmup_steps=0 --save_top_k=5"

TRAINING_CFG="${TRAINING_CFG_ALL_SIZES} ${TRAINING_CFG_SIZE_SPECIFIC}"

# Final command
srun --gpus-per-node 4 shifter --image=docker:jobirk/omnilearn-lightning:v1.0.3 bash -c "cd $REPO_DIR/scripts/ && source /opt/conda/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=${REPO_DIR}:$PYTHONPATH && python3 train_lightning.py $TRAINING_CFG --mode=classifier"

#srun --gpus-per-node 4 --gpus-per-task=1 -N 4 shifter --image=docker:jobirk/omnilearn-lightning:v1.0.3 bash -c "cd $REPO_DIR/scripts/ && source /opt/conda/bin/activate && export PYTHONPATH=${REPO_DIR}:$PYTHONPATH && python3 train_lightning.py $TRAINING_CFG --mode=classifier"
